cases.text:
Lemon tart

# Pastry
250 g plain flour
125 g cold butter
1 egg yolk

# Filling
4 eggs
150 ml lemon juice
> use unwaxed lemons

Method:
Rub the butter into the flour until it looks like sand.
Line the tin and blind bake for 15 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the juice.
Bake until the filling only just sets.
